text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, mild hypoalbuminemia, elevated creatinine, high ferritin, and increased alkaline phosphatase. INR is markedly elevated with a low PT, suggesting possible anticoagulation therapy or liver dysfunction. There is also mild inflammation (CRP near upper limit). Findings suggest possible infection/inflammation, impaired oxygenation, mild renal and hepatic dysfunction, and possible bone marrow suppression. Clinical correlation is recommended.
